# MIRA - Validated Third-Party Requirements
# Generated by analyzing actual usage across the codebase
# Each package verified to be actively used in non-deprecated files

# == LOCAL EMBEDDING STACK (not listed here) ==
# torch (CPU wheel) and sentence-transformers are installed only for the local
# embedding provider, by deploy/python.sh (gated on embedding_provider: local)
# and deploy/docker/Dockerfile.base. Remote-embedding installs never pull them.

# == WEB FRAMEWORK & SERVER ==
fastapi           # Core web framework - heavily used across API endpoints
starlette         # FastAPI dependency - used in middleware
hypercorn         # ASGI server with HTTP/2 support - required for all environments

# == DATABASE & DATA PERSISTENCE ==
psycopg[binary]>=3.1.0  # PostgreSQL driver v3 - postgres_client.py, database utils
psycopg-pool       # Connection pooling for psycopg v3
pgvector          # PostgreSQL vector extension - postgres_client.py

# == CACHING & KEY-VALUE STORE ==
valkey>=6.0.0      # Redis-compatible cache - valkey_client.py, many services

# == AUTHENTICATION & SECURITY ==
cryptography      # Encryption utilities - userdata_manager.py
email-validator   # Pydantic EmailStr validation - auth/api.py (multi-user signup)
webauthn          # Passkey registration and authentication - auth/webauthn_service.py (pulls cbor2)

# == AI & MACHINE LEARNING ==
anthropic>=0.78.0  # Anthropic Messages SDK - anthropic dialect; >=0.78.0 because clients/llm/dialects/anthropic.py sends output_config.effort on adaptive-thinking requests (output_config param: 0.77.0; effort in OutputConfigParam: 0.78.0). 0.x and 1.x both work: the dialect passes anthropic.Timeout (the SDK's re-export of its vendored httpx/httpx2 Timeout) so SDK 1.x's httpx2 switch is transparent.
numpy            # Numerical computing - embeddings, vector operations, ML utilities
scikit-learn>=1.4.0  # TF-IDF candidate discovery for memory linking pipeline

# == SCHEDULING & BACKGROUND TASKS ==
apscheduler      # Task scheduling - scheduler_service.py, lt_memory_jobs.py, sidebar_jobs.py

# == HTTP CLIENT & NETWORKING ==
httpx[http2]>=0.25.2  # Modern HTTP client with HTTP/2 support - tools, LLM provider, embeddings, weather/web tools; >=0.25.2 because utils/http_client.py's IP-pinning transport needs httpcore 1.x's public NetworkBackend/SyncBackend/SOCKET_OPTION (first httpx pinning httpcore==1.*)
mcp              # Model Context Protocol SDK - mcp_client.py for MCP server connections

# == TOOL-SPECIFIC LIBRARIES ==
google-genai     # Google Gemini GenAI SDK - imagegen_tool.py
kagiapi          # Kagi search API - web_tool.py (primary search provider)
ddgs             # DuckDuckGo search - web_tool.py (fallback search provider)
trafilatura      # Deterministic web content extraction - web_tool.py (replaces LLM extraction)
beautifulsoup4   # Last-resort HTML text extraction - web_tool.py (_fallback_text_extract after trafilatura fails)
hvac             # HashiCorp Vault client - vault_client.py

# == BILLING & PAYMENTS ==

# == IMAGE PROCESSING ==
Pillow>=10.0.0   # Image compression - two-tier compression for multimodal messages
pypdf>=5.0.0     # Provider-neutral PDF text extraction for document uploads

# == UTILITIES & HELPERS ==
pydantic         # Data validation - widely used across API models and tools
python-dateutil  # Date parsing - reminder_tool.py, timezone_utils.py
pytz             # Timezone handling - timezone_utils.py
colorama         # Terminal colors - logging_config.py
rapidfuzz        # Fuzzy string matching - memory deduplication, entity normalization
json-repair      # JSON repair for malformed LLM responses - memory_processor.py, subcortical.py
jsonschema       # Validate provider-returned tool arguments against ToolDefinition schemas
psutil           # Process management - playwright_service.py for forced browser shutdown

# == TESTING DEPENDENCIES ==
pytest           # Test framework - extensive test suite
pytest-asyncio   # Async test support - async tests

# == OPTIONAL DEPENDENCIES ==
# Deliberately NOT installed by `pip install -r requirements.txt`. MIRA runs
# without all three; each has a designed fallback. Install on demand:
#   pip install python-docx openpyxl playwright && playwright install chromium

# Document processing - richer DOCX/XLSX text extraction.
# utils/document_processing.py derives HAS_DOCX / HAS_OPENPYXL from ImportError
# and falls back to stdlib zipfile + ElementTree parsing (_extract_docx_stdlib,
# _extract_xlsx_stdlib). The stdlib path is verified equivalent to the library
# path for both inlineStr workbooks (what openpyxl itself writes) and
# sharedStrings workbooks, including rich-text <si> runs, sheet display names
# resolved from xl/workbook.xml, and true workbook sheet order.
#python-docx     # DOCX text extraction - document_processing.py
#openpyxl        # XLSX text extraction - document_processing.py

# JavaScript-rendered page capture.
# Two independently optional layers, which is why this was mislabelled before:
#   1. the PYTHON PACKAGE - web_tool._fetch_playwright() imports
#      utils.playwright_service lazily and maps ImportError to the error code
#      "playwright_unavailable". utils/playwright_service.py itself imports
#      playwright.sync_api at module level, but nothing imports that module
#      except the lazy call site and the POST check below.
#   2. the CHROMIUM BROWSER - what deploy actually gates, via
#      CONFIG_INSTALL_PLAYWRIGHT (deploy/python.sh Step 7, deploy/config.sh).
#      A missing browser surfaces as the distinct error code
#      "chromium_unavailable".
# The POST check is CheckSpec("playwright_service", required=False, ...), so its
# failure lands in advisory_failures and the gate still passes.
#playwright      # headless browser - playwright_service.py, web_tool.py

# Lattice federation - enables cross-server pager messaging (username@server)
# ImportError-guarded: MIRA runs fine without it (federation simply disabled).
# Not on PyPI. Install from the sibling repo, then run the discovery daemon:
#   git clone https://github.com/taylorsatula/lattice && pip install -e ./lattice
#   uvicorn lattice.discovery_daemon:app --port 1113
# Used by: main.py (username resolver), cns/api/federation.py, tools/implementations/pager_tool.py
# lattice      # (optional) Federation daemon client

# == PACKAGES TO REVIEW/CONSIDER REMOVING ==
# These packages have limited usage and may be removable:
# - pytz (could potentially use zoneinfo from Python 3.9+ instead)
